Counter-signal: the glucoside is the first-listed surfactant and the sulfate sits after glycerin, which argues for a milder net system; recorded as the counter-signal, neighbor low. The convention value is not moved.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful system (prominent cationic Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@12) plus light routes (Glycerin@3, Panthenol@7, weak refatters @9-11, @13-14). No silicone, payload lipid or pearlizing route, so C2 is not met; high not supported. Low is the neighbor because the cationic is a single light guar.
